newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines projects 7.8 pct GNP growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Philippines projects 7.8 pct GNP growth in 1997.

text.p: Philippine Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo said on Wednesday the country had set a Gross National Product growth target of 7.8 percent for 1997.
He also told a meeting with businessmen accompanying visiting Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien that the Philippines should cap inflation within 6.5 percent during the year.
